prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Conroe, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1108; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident details, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were driving when the collision happened?
A: I was in Conroe, Texas, heading toward a shopping center on the north side of the main road. I was turning left into the lot.
Q: What was the traffic like at the time?
A: Pretty steady. There was a car coming the other way, and I waited for it to pass. Then I saw a gap and started my turn.
Q: Did you have a green light or a turn arrow?
A: It was a green light, but there was no arrow for left turns. I yielded to oncoming traffic before going.
Q: What happened next?
A: A vehicle coming from the opposite direction hit the front passenger side of my car. I felt a hard jolt and my head snapped forward and back.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, I was.
Q: Did you hit your head on anything or lose consciousness?
A: No, I didn't lose consciousness. My head didn't hit anything, but my neck was really sore almost right away.
Q: Where are you feeling pain now?
A: My neck is stiff and it hurts when I turn to check my blind spot. My lower back is also aching, mostly when I sit for a long time.
Q: Have you seen a doctor or received treatment?
A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic that same day, and I've been doing physical therapy twice a week since then.
Q: Is there anything else you think I should know about the accident?
A: Just that I was driving carefully and I'm trying to get back to normal. I'm still dealing with the pain every day.
Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
A: Okay, thanks.
